headline: Advisory review of a 15,000-square-foot commercial storage building at 523 Mammoth Road, with wetland impact permit.
summary: The commission will give advice to the Planning Board on a site plan and wetland permit for a storage building. Other business includes its rules of procedure, the Londonderry Look Book, and a proposed list of historic properties from David Ellis.
items: Advisory input to Planning Board on site plan for a one-story 15,000-square-foot commercial storage building and site work at 523 Mammoth Road
Conditional use permit for 2,300 square feet of wetland impacts and 11,529 square feet of buffer impacts
Discussion of the Londonderry Look Book
Discussion of David Ellis proposed "The Londonderry NH List of Historic Properties"
plain_text:
Londonderry Heritage/Historic District Commission Meeting
November 19, 2026 - 7:00 P.M.
MOOSE HILL CONFERENCE ROOM
AGENDA
I. Open Meeting
II. Approval of minutes from prior meeting
III. Applications for Advisory input to the Planning Board
A. Application for design review of a site plan for a one story 15,000 Square foot commercial storage building 
and associated site improvements along with a Conditional Use Permit for 2,300 square feet of wetland 
impacts and 11,529 Square feet of buffer impacts in the Commercial – II (C-II) and  Industrial – II (IND-II) 
zoning district. 523 Mammoth Road, Tax Map 15, Lot 2, DJCA Cornerstone, LLC c/o Matt Stowell (Applicant) 
GMS Realty, LLC c/o Luc Choquette (Owner).   
IV. Other business
A. Discussion of Rules of Procedure
B. Discussion on the Londonderry Look Book
C. Discussion of David Ellis proposed "The Londonderry NH List of Historic Properties"
V. Public input
VI.  Adjournment
